subject: ensemble
source_sentence: In this paper, we propose a novel Multi-Layer Perceptron (MLP) based ensemble technique for fine-grained sentiment analysis.
title: A Multilayer Perceptron based Ensemble Technique for Fine-grained Financial Sentiment Analysis

subject: word-based
source_sentence: (2009) used word-based approach on financial blogs to train a sentiment classifier for automatically determining the sentiment towards companies and their stocks.
title: A Multilayer Perceptron based Ensemble Technique for Fine-grained Financial Sentiment Analysis

subject: Denoising Autoencoder
source_sentence: We further propose to develop an enhanced word representation by learning through a stacked denoising autoencoder network using word embeddings of Word2Vec and GloVe models.
title: A Multilayer Perceptron based Ensemble Technique for Fine-grained Financial Sentiment Analysis

subject: Support Vector Regression
source_sentence: We extract and implement following set of features to train a Support Vector Regression (SVR) for predicting the sentiment score in the continuous range of -1 to +1.
